nodes.description: The germline Slp76-null mouse, generated by homologous recombination, was the original in vivo model of SLP-76 loss. It exhibits impaired viability, a profound thymic developmental block, and hemorrhage. It informs the human disease but diverges from it in two ways relevant to IMD81: the complete null causes an absolute developmental block with no peripheral T cells (human hypomorphic alleles leave dysregulated peripheral T cells), and B-cell development is entirely normal (human patients have a B-cell antigen-receptor signaling defect).
